name: Hyrcanian Forests
story: The Hyrcanian forests cover about 55,000 square kilometres near the shores of the Caspian Sea in Iran and Azerbaijan. Designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2019, these lush lowland and montane forests are home to animals like the Persian leopard and brown bear.
matters: The ecoregion serves as a key green resting area for birds migrating between central-northern Russia and Africa, and functions as a vital refuge for unique endemic species.
